narrative.overview: SIKAWAL is the desk a clerk sits at to keep every letter moving: one glance tells you what each document is, who it's waiting on, and what to do next. The interface is the control surface for an evidence trail, not a showcase. A single deep civic blue (#0b56ad) carries authority and is spent sparingly; everything else is near-white canvas, white cards, soft borders, and ink-dark text tuned for legibility under bright office lighting. Hierarchy comes from weight and scale, not decoration. Depth is mostly flat: hairline borders and a whisper of shadow separate surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: One civic blue, spent sparingly; tonal soft-color badges carry workflow status.
Near-white canvas, white cards, hairline borders; flat by default.
Hierarchy through weight + scale, not ornament.
Legibility-first: tuned for non-technical staff under bright light, WCAG AA.
Status is always one glance away; the timeline is the proof.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Civic Blue appears on ≤10% of any screen: one primary action, the active nav item, focus rings. If two blue buttons compete on a screen, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Status-Hue Rule
rules.body: A status color is only ever a status. Never use amber, rose, sky, emerald, green, or zinc decoratively.

rules.name: The No-Warm-Cream Rule
rules.body: The canvas is cool near-white (#f9f9fb), never beige/sand/cream. Institutional calm, not warmth.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Need emphasis? Change weight or size, never add a typeface. The cap is one family.

rules.name: The 14px Floor Rule
rules.body: Body text never drops below 0.875rem (14px); 0.75rem is for labels and metadata only, never sentences.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Depth is carried by border + tonal contrast. If a surface needs more than shadow-sm to feel separated, the layout is wrong. No nested cards, ever.

dos: Do spend Civic Blue (#0b56ad) sparingly: one primary action, active nav, focus rings.
Do carry workflow meaning only through the seven status hues, used as soft badge + solid bar.
Do separate surfaces with hairline borders + Paper-to-white tonal step; reach for shadow-sm only as a whisper.
Do build hierarchy from weight and scale in one system font; keep body ≥14px and measure ≤75ch.
Do ring focus with :focus-visible and give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion path (WCAG AA).
Do keep Muted Ink (#616875) as the lightest readable gray; bump toward Ink if contrast is close to 4.5:1.
donts: Don't look like a jadul government app: no cramped gray tables without hierarchy, no generic gray buttons, no 2010s density.
Don't look like a playful startup: no loud/neon colors, no emoji, no cute illustration, no flashy gradients.
Don't look like a boring gray corporate template: no characterless blue-gray sameness.
Don't overdesign: no nested cards, no stacked drop shadows, no decorative animation, no card for everything.
Don't use a warm cream/sand/beige canvas; the surface is cool near-white (#f9f9fb).
Don't use a status hue decoratively, introduce a second typeface, or drop sentence text below 14px.
Don't use border-left/border-right >1px as a colored accent stripe, or background-clip:text gradient text.
